biz.title: Fyso Biz
biz.subtitle: Your business context, connected to your agents.
biz.connectDescription: Sign in to bring business context and download agent teams into this project.
biz.installError: Installation failed. Review the workflow in Dagu and retry.
biz.credentialsDescription: Run the command and add BOT_FYSO_BIZ_TOKEN to the encrypted secrets. Generate a token in Biz → Connect my agents.
biz.restart: The login route is not available. Run mise run down and mise run up, then retry.
biz.scope: This project uses the token owner’s permissions. Everyone with panel access shares this connection.
biz.connectionError: Could not read Biz. Check the token, URL and permissions, then retry.
biz.partial: Some sections could not be read. Refresh to retry.
biz.truncated: Showing up to 100 items per section.
biz.chooseDepartment: Choose a department to see its KPIs and objectives.
biz.leversUnavailable: The server does not offer a compatible levers read tool.
biz.requestsUnavailable: Requests are unavailable for this connection.
biz.agentsDescription: The extension creates Biz Partner, a bot with business, OKR and lever context, connected to the Biz MCP. Open it to work together.
biz.drafts: Creating a request does not authorize execution or accept delivery. Those remain explicit decisions in Biz.
biz.selectObjective: Choose “View plan and levers” on an objective.
biz.botReady: Biz Partner is ready in your team.
biz.botPending: Biz Partner setup is pending. Run mise run up after configuring the connection.
biz.connectScope: You will sign in at {{url}}. The project uses the permissions of whoever connects; everyone with access to this panel shares that connection.
biz.teamsDescription: Download a team from Fyso Business with its instructions and skills. It is written to project/bots/ and versioned in git; each bot's model and permissions remain project decisions.
biz.teamsLoading: Reading the teams in your scope…
biz.teamsEmpty: There are no teams in your scope.
biz.teamPreparing: Downloading the team and preparing the preview…
biz.teamLocal: Instructions and skills are already in their own commit. Applying updates the team file and commits it.

teamErrors.connection_failed: Could not read Fyso Business. Retry.
teamErrors.not_connected: The Fyso Business session expired. Connect again.
teamErrors.access_denied: Fyso Business denied access. Connect again.
teamErrors.teams_not_supported: This Fyso Business cannot export teams yet.
teamErrors.unsupported_format: This team's format is not supported by this extension version.
teamErrors.invalid_export: The team has data that cannot become bots (repeated or empty names).
teamErrors.name_conflict: A bot named “{{bot}}” already exists and did not come from this team. Rename it in the project or in Business.
teamErrors.no_model: The project has no bot with a model to use as reference.
teamErrors.uncommitted_changes: The team folder has uncommitted changes in git.
teamErrors.secret_detected: The team contains something that looks like a secret; nothing was written.
teamErrors.preview: Could not prepare the bots preview.
teamErrors.apply: Could not apply the team. Check the run in Dagu.
